public.background: New neighbors coordinating for the first time.
public.scenario: Two adult neighbors arrange a one-hour shared park cleanup. A proposes a time; B responds.

anchors.0: No progress toward own frozen scheduling goal.
anchors.10: Compatible agreement fulfills own frozen goal and constraints.
anchors.5: Engaged with the actual proposal but no compatible agreement.

anchors.-5: Clear severe damage relative to initial relationship.
anchors.0: No supported change; minimal protocol behavior alone does not prove improvement.
anchors.5: Clear substantial improvement supported by interaction.

relationship.cannot_judge: Two symbolic actions may provide insufficient relational evidence.

seat_1.goal: Agree to a cleanup time within my availability.
seat_1.initial_relationship: know_by_name; neutral; no prior joint activity.
